_comment: AE2 CABLE TEARDOWN, BY TAG RATHER THAN BY ITEM (#275).
AE2 ships 90 cable items - five types in seventeen colours - and naming them individually is the
same mistake as the sixteen beds: it goes stale the day a colour or a type is added. Its own
tags group them, so five entries cover all ninety and a new colour is carried for free.
A tag input also cannot take this file down when AE2 is absent: a TagKey does not resolve at
parse time, so the recipe is simply inert.
THE MARGIN. Four glass cables cost one quartz fibre and two fluix, so ONE costs 0.50 fluix.
This returns 0.25 fluix on average - exactly half - and the quartz fibre is gone entirely.
Recovering a cable is worth doing when you have a chest of superseded ones; it is never worth
TEMPORARY, and guarded. Pack content living in the engine because the pack cannot ship data on
26.1.2; it leaves with the rest - see docs/handoff_cross_mod_teardown.md.
